parameters.query:
insert into doc.documents
  (file_sha256, storage_path, source_filename,
   source_message_id, sender, received_at, ingest_status, mail_id)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7,
        doc.record_mail($4, $5, $8, $6, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13))
on conflict (file_sha256) do nothing
returning id, file_sha256, ingest_status, mail_id;

'received' : 'unapproved_sender', $('Ingest items').item.json.subject, $('Ingest items').item.json.sender_approved, $('Ingest items').item.json.attachment_count, $('Ingest items').item.json.pdf_count, $('Ingest items').item.json.mail_status, $('Ingest items').item.json.skipped_files] }}
